input: Apply for a remote work visa in Costa Rica

gold.taskTitle: Apply for a Remote Work Visa in Costa Rica
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to apply for Costa Rica's remote work (Rentista/Digital Nomad) visa and needs a clear, actionable plan to do so.

questions.title: What country is your current passport from?
questions.description: Nationality determines eligibility requirements, exemptions, and specific documentation needed for the Costa Rica digital nomad visa.

questions.title: Are you already living in Costa Rica or abroad?
questions.description: Whether the user is applying from inside Costa Rica or from their home country affects the application process and which consulate or office to use.

questions.title: What is your target move or start date?
questions.description: Understanding the desired timeline helps prioritize steps and flag any urgent deadlines in document gathering or appointments.

questions.title: Do you work for a foreign employer or are you self-employed?
questions.description: Employment type affects which proof-of-income documents are required, such as employer letters, contracts, or business registration records.

questions.title: Can you currently meet the $3,000 per month income requirement?
questions.description: Costa Rica's Digital Nomad Visa requires proof of at least $3,000/month in stable foreign income; knowing this upfront shapes the financial documentation plan.

questions.title: Will you be applying alone or with family members?
questions.description: Including dependents such as a spouse or children changes the required documents, fees, and the overall complexity of the application.

questions.title: Have you already gathered any documents for this visa?
questions.description: Knowing what the user already has, such as a police clearance, apostilled documents, or health insurance, avoids redundant steps in the plan.
